workspace_member_select.name: workspace_member_select
workspace_member_select.using: exists (select 1 from troupe_workspace_member m where m."workspaceId" = "troupe_workspace"."id" and m."userId" = auth.uid())

project_member_select.name: project_member_select
project_member_select.using: exists (select 1 from troupe_workspace_member m where m."workspaceId" = "troupe_project"."workspaceId" and m."userId" = auth.uid())

script_line_member_select.name: script_line_member_select
script_line_member_select.using: exists (select 1 from troupe_script s join troupe_project p on p.id = s."projectId" join troupe_workspace_member m on m."workspaceId" = p."workspaceId" where s.id = "troupe_script_line"."scriptId" and m."userId" = auth.uid())

actor_asset_visible_select.name: actor_asset_visible_select
actor_asset_visible_select.using: exists (select 1 from troupe_actor a where a.id = "troupe_actor_asset"."actorId" and (a."workspaceId" is null or exists (select 1 from troupe_workspace_member m where m."workspaceId" = a."workspaceId" and m."userId" = auth.uid())))
